translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 被害を出したわ。ﾇﾇﾇ
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "victims." *Nunununu*

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "seeking to thin out the overpopulated numbers of the Holses."

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「……鋭いですな。そう考える科学者は多いです。
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "...A very sharp observation. Many of our scientists believe the exact same thing."

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 無論、だからと言ってむざむざと
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Of course, just because it may be the will of our species,"

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "doesn't mean we will simply stand by and let ourselves be slaughtered!" *Nunununu*

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "The death toll reached into the thousands,"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 大勢のホルスの犠牲により
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "and only after sacrificing the lives of countless Holses"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: ようやく捕らえたのじゃが……ﾇﾇﾇ」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "did we finally succeed in capturing him..." *Nunununu*

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「密航していたみたいでね……
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "But it seems he managed to stow away on this vessel..."

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 奴もこの中に眠っている。ﾇﾇﾇ」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "He is currently sleeping inside one of these chambers." *Nunununu*

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "And as I said earlier, we don't know who is in which device." *Nunununu*

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Nunununu."

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "We desperately wish to awaken Lady Terra, but..."

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 間違えてジャハルッカスを起こすわけには
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "we simply cannot risk waking Jaharukkas by mistake,"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: いかないと、こういうわけじゃ。ﾇﾇﾇ」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "that's why things are like this." *Nunununu*

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「ふーん……
「ふふふん」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Fufufun."

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Ah, Rance-san, let's stop."

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「？　ﾇﾇﾇ」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「なっ……ﾇﾇﾇ」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Rance-kun, did you not listen to a single word they said?"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: さすがにそれはやりすぎよ」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Waking him up by mistake would be an absolute disaster!"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「がははははははは！
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Gahahahahahaha!

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Relax! I've got the devil's own luck!"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 特に美女が絡むことは１００％だ！」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Especially when it comes to claiming beautiful women, my success rate is 100%!"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「ここだーーーッ！
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Here it is---!

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Phew...

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: どうやら誰も使ってないようだがな。ﾇﾇﾇ」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Oh? And here I thought this whole ship was nothing but cold, hard metal,"

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "but there's actually a pretty high-grade bed in here."

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Alright, Sill, come here!"

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Caesar, wait over there!"

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "I'll beat some discipline into this perverted scoundrel myself!"

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「ちょ、ちょっと三人とも、落ち着いて――
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "H-Hey, all three of you, calm down—

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Wait, whoa, whoa! Don't pull my arm!"

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Inside the family-use cold sleep device,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: the four of them get tangled up.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "Haniho, aiya—"

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: The cold sleep device closes,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and in no time, the inside fills with cold air.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「さむっ、さむっ！　わー、出せー！
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: "It's freezing! It's freezing! Ahhh, let me out!

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: だせ……だ……ぐう……
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Let me out... let... *chatter*... uugh..."

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: そしてランス達は眠ってしまった。
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: And then Rance and the others fell asleep.
